As the Balkans navigate an increasingly complex energy reality, defined by energy security imperatives, infrastructure development, and growing investment flows - the role of upstream exploration remains critical to building a balanced and resilient regional energy system. The Summit is endorsed by four ministries across Greece, Romania, Albania, and Bulgaria.
